name: Language Tags
description: Checks that <html> has a lang attribute in the simple 'll' or 'll-RR' form using a recognised language (and region) code; hreflang and Content-Language meta are recorded. Language declaration helps LLMs and search engines interpret and route content to the right locale.

scoring.summary: Start at 3. Missing or whitespace-only lang: -2. If present it must match language[-Script][-REGION] (/^([a-z]{2,3})(-[a-z]{4})?(-([a-z]{2}|\d{3}))?$/i) else -0.5; if it matches but the language code is neither in the extension's 70-code list nor known to the runtime's ICU data (Intl.DisplayNames), -0.5; else if a region is present and is neither numeric (UN M.49), in the 70-region list, nor known to ICU, -0.25. hreflang and Content-Language are informational (finding only, no points). Score = max(0, score), floored by the engine.

rules.condition: html lang attribute missing or trim() empty
lang.trim() does not match /^([a-z]{2,3})(?:-([a-z]{4}))?(?:-([a-z]{2}|\d{3}))?$/i (e.g. 'en_US', 'en-US-x-foo' fail; 'zh-Hans', 'zh-Hant-TW', 'es-419' pass)

language code (lowercased) not in the extension list (en es fr de it pt ru ja ko zh ar hi bn pa te mr ta ur gu kn nl pl uk ro el hu cs sv da fi no nb nn tr th vi id ms he fa sw tl fil ca eu gl sr hr bs sk sl bg mk sq et lv lt mt is ga cy af zu xh am ne si km lo my) AND Intl.DisplayNames has no English name for it

else region present (uppercased), not a 3-digit UN M.49 code, not in the extension list (US GB CA AU NZ IE ZA IN PK NG ES MX AR CO PE VE CL EC GT CU FR BE CH LU MC DE AT IT PT BR RU UA BY KZ JP KR CN TW HK SG NL PL RO GR HU CZ SE DK FI NO TR TH VN ID MY PH IL AE SA EG KE GH MA DZ TN LY ET TZ UG ZW) AND Intl.DisplayNames has no name for it
more than 1 link[hreflang] and none has hreflang exactly 'x-default'
score = max(0, score); the engine floors it to an integer

scoring.status_mapping: From the floored integer score: 3 pass, 2 warning, 0-1 fail. Valid lang => 3 pass; unknown region, bad format or unknown language => 2 warning; missing lang => 1 fail.

detect.source_procedure: Find the root <html> tag per page. Static HTML / Vite: <html lang> in *.html / index.html. Astro: <html lang=...> in src/layouts/*.astro (may be a variable such as Astro.currentLocale). Hugo: layouts/_default/baseof.html, typically lang="{{ .Site.LanguageCode }}" or {{ site.Language.LanguageCode }}; resolve from languageCode / defaultContentLanguage in hugo.toml/config.toml (Hugo languageCode like 'en-us' passes: regex is case-insensitive and region is uppercased). Eleventy: base layout in _includes/**, lang from _data/site.* or front matter. Next.js app router: <html lang> in app/layout.tsx (or app/[locale]/layout.tsx); pages router: <Html lang> in pages/_document.tsx, or i18n.defaultLocale in next.config.js (Next adds lang automatically when i18n is configured). Resolve the value and apply the rules; collect <link rel=alternate hreflang> for informational output.

parity.note: Exact for literal lang values. Differs when lang is a template variable resolved at build/runtime, set by client-side i18n libraries after load, or added by a framework automatically (Next.js i18n). hreflang has no score impact so mismatches there do not matter.

fix_summary: Set <html lang="en"> (or the correct 'll' / 'll-RR' code such as en-US) in the root layout: index.html, Astro layout, Hugo baseof.html with languageCode in hugo.toml, Eleventy base layout, Next.js app/layout.tsx or pages/_document.tsx.

divergences.extension: Valid BCP 47 tags with a script subtag or numeric region (zh-Hans, zh-Hant-TW, es-419) fail the format regex (-0.5).
divergences.plugin: language[-Script][-REGION] with a 2-letter or 3-digit region is accepted.
divergences.reason: These are correct language tags; penalizing them was a false positive.

divergences.extension: Only a 70-language and 70-region subset counts as known, so valid codes like 'la', 'eo' or the region in 'lv-LV' are penalized.
divergences.plugin: A code outside those lists still counts as known when the runtime's ICU data (Intl.DisplayNames) has a name for it.
divergences.reason: False positives on valid ISO 639 / ISO 3166 codes.

divergences.extension: Status comes from the unrounded score, so any lang issue shows 'pass' with 2/3 points and 'warning' is unreachable.
divergences.plugin: Status is derived from the reported integer score (2/3 is a warning).
